comparison: Completed 100-epoch seed-42 pairs; earlier submitted run versus later chat-derived run.
visual_assessment: Same qualitative contrast: beta=4 has relatively selective position, scale and rotation coordinates; beta=1 has more mixed responses and traversals. Neither is perfectly disentangled.
observed_difference: The new beta=1 run has six low-variance coordinates, versus five in the submitted run. Coordinate identities, signs, response shapes and traversal details differ.
reference_image_difference: Old zero-based scale index 3, new scale index 2; both use an oval at rotation 0 and positions 16,16. Traversal pixels are not a matched-reference quantitative test.
comparison_limits: One pair per implementation; not a statistical equivalence or robustness test. Posterior-mean reconstruction is not the expected ELBO reconstruction term.
decision: Similar qualitative result and comparable reconstruction/KL; publish only as a separate later run.
